column3: Close to the Hebrew; “on the altar” is rendered “by the altar,” “the capital” “the doorposts,” and “their posterity” “the last of them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Sheol” is rendered “hell.”
Close to the Hebrew; “it melted” is rendered “it melts.”
Close to the Hebrew; “his stairs (upper chambers)” is rendered “His layers,” and “his vault” “His strata.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the Cushites” is rendered “the people of Ethiopia,” and “Aram” “the Syrians.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a pebble” is rendered “the smallest grain,” and NKJV supplies “grain” in “As grain is sifted.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the booth of David” is rendered “The tabernacle of David,” and “I will wall up their breaches” “repair its damages.”
Close to the Hebrew; “dispossess” is rendered “possess,” and “the nations” “the Gentiles.”
